Israeli strikes in Gaza result in multiple fatalities

Israeli airstrikes have continued in Gaza, leading to a significant number of casualties. Reports indicate that dozens of people, including police officers, have been killed. The situation highlights the fragility of any existing ceasefire agreements in the region.
